subject: Post-call: RTBF / deletion workflow & timeline (FintechCo)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <privacy@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: RTBF/Deletion requirements & next steps

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps:

Summary of requirements (as discussed)
- Scope: deletion of PII (user identifiers, profile attributes), conversation logs (inputs/outputs), and customer-owned embeddings generated via Redwood API.
- Compliance needs: certificate of deletion for audit, statement of remaining retention windows, and confirmation that no data used for model training.
- Residency: customer data must remain in us-east region; any backups/snapshots must be identified.

Redwood default behavior (high-level)
- Application data + primary storage: we can purge account-level objects (records, embeddings, generated outputs) within 48-72 hours after an authenticated RTBF request.
- Operational logs: request-level logs (debug/tracing) are retained by default for 30 days; retention can be configured via contract.
- Backups & snapshots: encrypted backups are on a scheduled retention cycle (30-90 days depending on the backup tier). Immutable snapshots may require up to 30 days to complete a full purge; we will provide the exact snapshot windows.
- Certificates & evidence: we can provide a deletion certificate and a short attestation; for formal audit artifacts we typically route requests through Security/Legal and provide a signed statement.

Constraints / trade-offs we discussed
- Immediate purging from live systems is straightforward; purging from historical encrypted backups and provider immutable snapshots can take longer and sometimes requires coordination with infra/storage partners.
- For customers needing guaranteed faster backup purge, we offer an expedited purge addendum (operational charge + SOW).

Attachments include: RTBF_workflow_v1.pdf (runbook), backup_retention_chart.png (retention windows), deletion_checklist.csv (needed fields).

Next steps (action items)
1) I will loop in Security/Ops to confirm exact backup snapshot windows and whether we can commit to a shorter purge SLA. (ETA: by end of day tomorrow)
2) Please confirm the exact scope of PII you want removed (list of data types / datasets).
3) Let me know if you need an expedited purge SLA — we can surface pricing and contract language.
4) Proposed follow-up: 30-min call with our Security lead (Ethan) to align on evidence and certificate content.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Maya — thanks for the questions, and appreciate the audit timeline — we should be able to work toward the Apr 10 window but need to confirm a few operational items. Answers below and plan:

Q1 — 'Complete' purge SLA
- Live data (primary stores, embeddings in customer namespace): target 48-72 hours after authenticated RTBF request (we will run a deletion job and confirm job completion).
- Operational logs: default 30-day retention; we can shorten to 7-14 days with contract config but logs captured in third-party monitoring (if any) might have different rules.
- Backups & snapshots: standard process is scheduled retention; for typical backup tier the maximum time to ensure removal from all backups is 30 days after the deletion job completes. Immutable provider snapshots can extend that window to as much as 60-90 days depending on the provider and snapshot policy. We will confirm the exact numbers for your account (storage tier) — action for Security/Ops.

Q2 — embeddings
- Embeddings created under your customer namespace are deletable; they are not merged into a cross-customer index. We will run namespaced deletion and verify by ID range.

Q3 — fees for expedited purge
- We do offer an expedited purge service (operational surcharge + SOW) that shortens the backup/snapshot purge window; I will include pricing options after Ops confirms feasibility.

Evidence / certificate
- We can provide a deletion certificate and an attestation signed by our security team. For audit-grade artifacts (hashes of deletion jobs, ticket IDs, and logs), we will coordinate via Security and provide a standard evidence bundle.

Plan / next steps
1) Internal: Ethan/Dev — please confirm storage tier for FintechCo and provide exact backup/snapshot purge windows and whether expedited purge is feasible.
2) Maya: please confirm final PII scope (we attached deletion_checklist.csv; if you can populate and return we will kick the job).
3) Camila will follow up with a proposed SOW/expedite pricing if Ops says feasible (ETA pricing: 1 business day after Ops confirmation).

If Apr 10 is a hard audit date, please mark that in the checklist and we will prioritize the ticket. We may need a short addendum for expedited handling.

Best,
Camila
